name: Recioto di Gambellara

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A Veneto DOCG for white Recioto made only from Garganega grapes that are dried after harvest. The Classico is medium-sweet or sweet, and there is also a sparkling version. Its communes are Gambellara, Montebello Vicentino, Montorso Vicentino and Zermeghedo.
